name: Sign Out
summary: Terminates the current authenticated client session, revoking the current refresh token for token-backed sessions and ending the cookie session for browser-backed sessions.

sourceReferences.note: SignOutAsync delegates the authenticated sign-out request to the typed sign-out flow handler and accepts only the canonical sign-out success transition.
The handler revokes the supplied current refresh token when present, ends the sign-in session and records UserLogout.
